method: Local Whisper-small native sentence/phrase timestamps, matched to measured FFmpeg silencedetect -33dB pause boundaries (70ms and 200ms). No uniform or storyboard-estimated subtitle durations.
tailASRRetry: Long-tail decoder repetition was discarded; final font/wedding/EP04 lines retranscribed separately, bounded by measured pauses.
scriptAuthority: Approved transcript with ASR spelling corrections for sketsa, charcoal, cream, lime, olive and font. Colloquial pronunciation is not treated as a script rewrite.
